name: Inotani Keiko
source:
Director of Inotani Obstetrics and Gynecology Clinic.

She's blunt, but good at her job. A well-known doctor in the area.

She doesn't hesitate to use her body if necessary to put her son, who seems to be wondering whether to take over the hospital or not, on the path to success.

(Adapted and translated from home page.)
